description: Pinned upstream revisions for a Veil build. This file is the project's INTENT. The build's actual revision lock is the generated `.gclient_entries` in the workspace, which must be snapshotted into upstream/lock/ for any reproducible build.

brave-core.role: Primary upstream. Brave's layer over Chromium: source, GN build integration and patch tooling.
brave-core.note: brave-core MUST live at <workspace>/src/brave. Upstream instructions are explicit about this path.

chromium.license: BSD-3-Clause (project default; many bundled components carry their own licenses)
chromium.note: brave-core's generated .gclient points the `src` solution at the brave/chromium mirror rather than chromium.googlesource.com directly.

depot_tools.role: Chromium build tooling bootstrap: gclient, gn, ninja/autoninja wrappers.
depot_tools.note: Fetched automatically by `pnpm run init`. Do NOT use the Git bundled inside depot_tools - it is incompatible with Brave's plaster patch tooling.

brave-browser.role: THIN repository. Issues, releases and wiki only. NOT buildable, NOT used in a build.
brave-browser.used_for: release/version signal and documentation source only
brave-browser.upstream_readme_statement: This repository is not needed for building the browser and only holds issues, releases and the wiki. The source code and contributions are at https://github.com/brave/brave-core.

adblock-rust.role: Brave's adblock engine, linked into brave-core via brave/adblock-rust-ffi.
adblock-rust.ref: resolved by brave-core at sync time
adblock-rust.note: Pinned indirectly. Record the resolved revision in upstream/lock/ for a reproducible build.

git.note: The Git bundled in depot_tools must NOT be used.

visual_studio.windows: Visual Studio Community 2022, Update 17.8.3 or later, with Desktop development with C++ and the Windows SDK
visual_studio.note: Upstream's Windows guide mandates it. Brave's init sets USE_BRAVE_HERMETIC_TOOLCHAIN=1, which may supplement but does not demonstrably replace a local install. Treat as required until demonstrated otherwise.

build_system.fetch: gclient sync (bootstrapped by `pnpm run init`), ~240 repositories, ~60 GB decompressed
build_system.compile: autoninja (Brave customises siso as the underlying distributed build system)

authoritative_commands.note: All of the above are executed with the working directory set to <workspace>/src/brave.

privacy_constraints.principle: A Veil build supplies none of Brave's build-time service credentials. See .env.example.

reproducibility.current_state: INTENT ONLY - no build has been performed, so no .gclient_entries snapshot exists yet.
reproducibility.required_action: After the first successful sync, copy <workspace>/.gclient_entries to upstream/lock/<date>-<brave-core-version>-gclient-entries.txt and reference it here.
